item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-967e0b349316784f","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 27 December 2023, Sheikh Hasina unveiled an Awami League manifesto promising affordable commodity prices, youth employment, Smart Bangladesh, agricultural and industrial investment, banking-sector capacity, accessible healthcare, universal pensions, accountable law enforcement, prevention of communalism and militancy, and protection of democratic systems.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.1","4B.3","4B.7","5B.1","5B.4","5B.6","5B.9","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Dated manifesto issued during 2023; records intended future policy rather than completed implementation.","ruler_attribution":"Sheikh Hasina unveiled the manifesto as Awami League president and prime minister.","limitations":["Party-source account; implementation and independent verification are not shown."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7adbeb318420e056","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"CIVICUS reported that in 2023 authorities carried out mass arrests of BNP protesters, filed thousands of allegedly fabricated cases, and that police and alleged Awami League supporters used sticks, tear gas, rubber bullets, and live ammunition; it also reported forced disappearances, harassment of defenders, prosecution of journalists, and shutdowns of critical outlets ahead of the January election.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.3","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","4B.2","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Report dated 21 September 2023 and describes events occurring during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"CIVICUS attributed the conduct to authorities and the government of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["Claims are reported by an external civil-society monitor and are not adjudicated findings in this document."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5de030992111047e","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty reported that an opposition-led protest crackdown in July 2023 involved the death of at least one activist, hundreds injured, alleged indiscriminate police firearms use, and arrests of opposition leaders; it called for restraint, impartial investigation, and accountability.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Events and statement are from July 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The document addresses Bangladeshi authorities during Sheikh Hasina's premiership; it does not establish her personal operational involvement.","limitations":["Reported allegations and advocacy recommendations; no investigation outcome is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b4cb66fb01313f2a","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 23 June 2023, Sheikh Hasina publicly claimed that the Awami League had reduced poverty from 41% to 18% and hardcore poverty from over 25% to 5% during 2009–2023, expanded literacy and health outcomes, achieved food self-sufficiency, expanded electricity, healthcare and rural internet access, and built the Padma Bridge with domestic financing; she also urged vigilance against BNP-Jamaat, describing them as terrorist organizations that would destroy Bangladesh.","question_ids":["3B.3","5B.1","5B.6","5B.7","5B.8","5B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.10","7B.1","8B.1","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Public speech dated 23 June 2023; claimed outcomes span 2009–2023.","ruler_attribution":"Directly attributed to Sheikh Hasina in a party publication.","limitations":["Claims are self-reported and not independently corroborated here; rhetoric about opponents may contribute to threat framing."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1b89e3f297e1bd07","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"UNESCO reported that journalist Golam Rabbani Nadim was attacked by a group armed with machetes and iron bars on 15 June 2023 and died the next day; UNESCO urged Bangladeshi authorities to continue investigations and bring all perpetrators to justice, warning that such attacks endanger expression and induce journalist self-censorship.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.3","3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Killing occurred in June 2023; UNESCO statement dated 15 June 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Calls were directed to Bangladeshi authorities; the source does not attribute the attack personally to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["The document reports the killing and calls for investigation but gives no outcome or attribution of perpetrators."]},{"source_id":"SRC-65d0d497b3185cf2","start_unit":4,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The Election Commission Secretariat describes a dedicated constitutional election administration with regional, district, and subdistrict offices, responsibility for voter lists, constituency boundaries, election conduct, officer appointments, ballot supply, result publication, election tribunals, records, reports, and implementation of court directions.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.8","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Institutional description accessed for the 2023–2023 period, but the page is current and does not document specific 2023 conduct.","ruler_attribution":"Institutional description of the Bangladesh Election Commission Secretariat; no direct personal attribution to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["Shows formal institutional capacity and responsibilities, not independence in practice or the conduct of the 2023 election."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3f5569c2cc6cdae3","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"After Cabinet approval on 30 August 2023, Amnesty said the draft Cyber Security Act largely replicated the Digital Security Act, retained broad provisions affecting expression, privacy and liberty, and could enable intimidation, harassment, arbitrary arrest, suppression of dissent, and silencing of journalists and defenders; approximately 900 stakeholder recommendations were reportedly submitted before approval.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","6B.8","7B.2","8B.2","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Drafting and Cabinet approval occurred in August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Cabinet approval occurred under Sheikh Hasina's government; the source does not document her personal decision or the law's final enactment.","limitations":["Amnesty's legal assessment and reported process; final legislative outcome and implementation are not provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e23e82e476832ce5","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"WHO reported substantial long-term socioeconomic and health progress in Bangladesh, including poverty reduction, women's education, life expectancy, lower child and maternal mortality, improved immunization, and reduced infectious disease; it also identified persistent high household out-of-pocket costs, unequal access, poor quality, provider shortages, informal providers, and a need to strengthen pandemic preparedness and early response.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.6","6B.8","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Country strategy published 11 January 2023 and assesses conditions relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Describes Bangladesh's government and health system; not all progress is attributed personally to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["Strategy-level assessment; it does not isolate 2023 decisions or personal responsibility."]},{"source_id":"SRC-46ba80c48015e5c7","start_unit":3,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The Bangladesh Government Press archive lists 2023 extraordinary-gazette search and publication infrastructure across the Prime Minister's Office, ministries, police, Election Commission, courts, audit bodies, and other agencies, with date and ministry filters.","question_ids":["4B.4","5B.3","5B.7","6B.5","7B.6","7B.7","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Archive is specifically for extraordinary gazettes of 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Government publication infrastructure under the state apparatus; no specific Sheikh Hasina decision or gazette is identified.","limitations":["The page provides an archive interface and ministry index, not substantive 2023 measures or evidence of compliance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2d7f9ba7c1443180","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 3 May 2023, Law Minister Anisul Huq said the government would not repeal the Digital Security Act but would refine it to reduce misuse and abuse, while asserting protections for truthful journalists; he also stated that the government had enacted the Right to Information Act and authorized numerous television and radio channels.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.1","7B.8","8B.2","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Statement dated 3 May 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The minister explicitly attributed the policy to Sheikh Hasina's government and invoked her support for media freedom.","limitations":["Government position and claims; the document does not independently test enforcement or media conditions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f8bf642e70a4cff4","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty reported that July 28–29, 2023 opposition protests demanding Sheikh Hasina's resignation ended in clashes with police; the Home Minister said around 700 people were detained, while Amnesty reported excessive force, widespread arrests, attacks on opposition leaders, two deaths and hundreds hospitalized, and urged de-escalation, impartial investigations, and proportionate policing.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","3B.9","4B.2","4B.3","4B.9","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Events occurred 28–29 July 2023; statement dated 31 July 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The protests concerned demands for Sheikh Hasina's resignation and the conduct is attributed to Bangladeshi authorities; personal operational responsibility is not established.","limitations":["Reports and allegations summarized by Amnesty; no completed accountability process is reported."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-d54eb9ae19cb8df9"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied documents are heterogeneous and several are party or government statements; claims are preserved with source limitations rather than independently resolved.","No supplied document provides material evidence on nuclear, biological, AI, cyber-safety governance beyond the Cyber Security Act, arms control, proliferation, international conflict, corruption or personal enrichment, or ruler appointments sufficient for distinct factual claims."]}
